note: Palettes are design starting points, not compliance claims. Verify the chosen palette against the rendered figure: colour must never be the only channel.

wong.label: Okabe-Ito / Wong 2011 (colourblind safe)
wong.note: The reference colourblind-safe set. Black is the 8th series, not a background.

wong-6.label: Wong without black and yellow
wong-6.use: categorical, up to 6 series on white
wong-6.note: Drops the two entries that lose contrast on white or duplicate black.

tol-bright.label: Paul Tol bright
tol-bright.note: Tol's bright scheme; the grey is a neutral 'other' series.

tol-muted.label: Paul Tol muted
tol-muted.note: Muted scheme for print; adjacent entries are ordered to stay distinguishable.

tol-vibrant.label: Paul Tol vibrant
tol-vibrant.note: High chroma; not recommended for dense multi-panel print figures.

ibm.label: IBM design library colourblind safe
ibm.note: Tuned for UI; blue/violet pair separates weakly in grayscale.

grayscale-6.label: Grayscale sequence
grayscale-6.note: For B&W journals; pair with distinct markers, never rely on shade alone.

emphasis.label: One accent plus neutrals
emphasis.note: Accent first, then secondary, then two greys for context.

diverging.label: Diverging around zero (colourblind safe)
diverging.note: Symmetric ramp with a white centre at exactly zero; use a TwoSlopeNorm.

sequential.label: Sequential (viridis samples)
sequential.note: Prefer the live 'viridis' colormap; these samples are for discrete legends.
